components.name: AvatarFallback
components.summary: Fallback text or icon when avatar image fails to load
components.description: Radix Avatar fallback slot; renders initials or a generic icon when the image source is unavailable.

components.name: AvatarImage
components.description: Radix Avatar image slot; handles loading state and triggers the fallback when the image cannot be loaded.

components.name: BtcAveragePrice
components.summary: Read-only BTC average price display for reporting toolbars
components.description: Displays a formatted BTC/USD price with a configurable label. Shows a dash when the value is absent, non-finite, or negative.

components.name: DataLabel
components.summary: Formatted date range label for pickers and reporting headers
components.description: Renders a start/end date pair formatted as dd/MM/yy in the active app timezone, with a configurable prefix label.

components.name: AppHeader
components.summary: Top-bar application shell with branding, navigation, and action slots
components.description: Full-width application header that composes MdkWordmark, AlarmsBellButton, ProfileMenu, and HeaderStatsBar into a single responsive bar.

components.name: MdkWordmark
components.description: SVG wordmark rendered at sm, md, or lg sizes. Used in AppHeader and standalone brand placements.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.summary: Dropdown select with multi-value checkbox selection
components.description: Popover-based select that combines checkboxes with an inline trigger showing selected count. Supports keyboard navigation and controlled/uncontrolled modes.

components.name: SimplePopover
components.description: Convenience wrapper around Popover/PopoverTrigger/PopoverContent that accepts a single trigger element and content node.

components.name: SimpleTooltip
components.description: Convenience wrapper around Tooltip/TooltipProvider/TooltipTrigger/TooltipContent that accepts a single trigger and content prop.

components.name: Toaster
components.description: Radix Toast-based notification viewport. Mount once at the app root; individual toasts are dispatched via the useToast hook.

components.name: AlarmsBellButton
components.summary: Top-bar bell button with three-line severity alarm badge
components.description: Renders critical/high/medium alarm counts in a stacked badge on a bell icon button. Typically placed in AppHeader to route to the alerts view.

components.name: Alerts
components.summary: Current and historical alerts log view
components.description: Full-page alerts surface combining current and historical alert tabs. Consumes alarm data from the MDK adapter store.

components.name: DashboardDateRangePicker
components.description: Date range picker scoped to dashboard context; syncs selected range to the adapter store for stat widgets and charts.

components.name: ExportButton
components.description: Button that triggers a CSV/PDF export of dashboard statistics. Surfaces a toast notification on completion.

components.name: HeaderConsumptionBox
components.summary: Header stat box for total power consumption
components.description: Compact header widget displaying total power consumption with a trend indicator. Part of the HeaderStatsBar layout.

components.name: HeaderEfficiencyBox
components.summary: Header stat box for mining efficiency
components.description: Compact header widget displaying fleet efficiency in J/TH. Part of the HeaderStatsBar layout.

components.name: HeaderHashrateBox
components.summary: Header stat box for total fleet hashrate
components.description: Compact header widget displaying total fleet hashrate with a trend indicator. Part of the HeaderStatsBar layout.

components.name: HeaderMinersBox
components.summary: Header stat box for active miner count
components.description: Compact header widget displaying online/offline miner counts. Part of the HeaderStatsBar layout.

components.name: HeaderStatsBar
components.summary: Horizontal bar of real-time stat boxes in the app header
components.description: Arranges HeaderConsumptionBox, HeaderEfficiencyBox, HeaderHashrateBox, and HeaderMinersBox in a horizontal bar below the main app header.

components.name: ProfileMenu
components.summary: User profile dropdown menu in the app header
components.description: Avatar button that opens a dropdown with user info, settings link, and sign-out action. Reads user identity from the adapter store.

components.name: BitdeerOptions
components.summary: Bitdeer container options and configuration panel
components.description: Options panel for Bitdeer containers, providing brand-specific settings and control actions alongside the generic container controls.

components.name: AssignPoolModal
components.summary: Modal dialog for assigning a pool to selected miners
components.description: Dialog that lists available pools and assigns the selected one to a set of miners via the MDK adapter store.

components.name: PoolManagerSitesOverview
components.summary: Sites overview table in the pool manager
components.description: Tabular overview of all sites with pool assignment status, miner counts, and hashrate for the pool manager.

components.name: Cost
components.summary: Cost summary reporting page with chart and metric tiles
components.description: Single-site cost summary composite: page header, period selector slot, and a 2×2 grid of cost charts and metric tiles.

components.name: Ebitda
components.summary: EBITDA reporting view with charts and metrics
components.description: Renders EBITDA charts and metric tiles from a display-metrics view model. Accepts bar chart data for revenue, cost, and EBITDA series.

components.name: EnergyBalance
components.summary: Energy balance reporting view with cost and revenue tabs
components.description: Tabbed reporting surface showing energy cost and energy revenue balance with bar charts and period-level metric tiles.

components.name: HashBalance
components.description: Reporting composite for hash-rate balance across the pool, showing contribution, theoretical, and accepted hash metrics.

components.name: SubsidyFee
components.summary: Subsidy fee bar chart with single-stat metric
components.description: Bar chart of subsidy fees over a configurable time range alongside an average-fee metric tile.

components.name: RevenueChart
components.summary: Stacked bar chart of monthly revenue per site
components.description: Stacked bar chart displaying monthly revenue per site across the selected period. Automatically switches between BTC and Sats display based on value scale. Receives pre-fetched data as props — no internal data fetching.

components.name: EnergyReport
components.description: Multi-tab reporting surface for operational energy data: site view and miner-type breakdown charts.

components.name: Hashrate
components.description: Multi-tab reporting surface for fleet hashrate: site view and mining-unit breakdown charts.

components.name: OperationalDashboard
components.summary: 2×2 grid of site-operations charts (hashrate, power, efficiency, miners status)
components.description: Composite operational dashboard showing a 2×2 grid of line-trend and stacked-bar charts. Each card can expand to full width; expand state persists across remounts. Pair with useOperationsDashboard to shape raw metric logs into chart-ready payloads.

components.name: ReportTimeFrameSelector
components.summary: Preset-window picker (1D / 7D / 30D / custom) for operational reporting bar views
components.description: Compact preset-window and custom date range control used inside efficiency and hashrate bar views. Pair with useReportTimeFrameSelectorState for controlled state.

components.name: SiteReports
components.description: Aggregates financial and operational reporting metrics across multiple sites for portfolio-level analysis.

components.name: TimeframeControls
components.summary: Preset and custom time range picker for reporting views
components.description: Year/month preset selector with custom date range override, shared across financial and operational reporting surfaces.

components.name: MetricCard
components.summary: Single-metric card tile for reporting dashboards
components.description: Compact card displaying a metric label, formatted value, unit, and optional trend indicator for reporting composite layouts.

components.name: MovementDetailsModal
components.summary: Modal detailing a historical device movement
components.description: Modal showing the details of a historical device movement: the device summary plus the origin to destination transition of location and status. Receives the selected movement as a prop; no internal data fetching.

components.name: RepairLogChangesSubRow
components.summary: Expandable sub-row listing spare-part changes in a repair batch
components.description: Expandable sub-row that lists the spare-part changes recorded in a repair batch action. Each non-miner repair action is resolved against its device to show the part type, serial number, MAC address, and whether the part was added or removed.

components.name: CostContent
components.summary: Data-driven 2x2 grid body of the Cost page
components.description: Renders the data-driven portion of the Cost page in a 2x2 Mosaic grid (production cost chart, operations energy chart, avg all-in cost chart, and cost metric tiles). Building block of the Cost composite.

components.name: CostMetrics
components.description: Three $/MWh tiles that summarise the cost-summary period. Order mirrors the OSS Cost page: All-in (highlighted), Energy, Operations. Building block of the Cost composite.

components.name: AvgAllInCostChart
components.summary: Revenue vs cost ($/MWh) bar chart over time
components.description: Avg All-in Cost - revenue vs cost ($/MWh) bar chart over time. Building block of the Cost composite.

components.name: ProductionCostChart
components.summary: Production cost over time, overlaid with BTC price
components.description: Production cost over time, overlaid with BTC price. Building block of the Cost composite.

components.name: OperationsEnergyChart
components.summary: Doughnut breakdown of operations vs energy cost
components.description: Doughnut breakdown of Operations vs Energy cost (in USD totals). Building block of the Cost composite.

components.name: EbitdaMetrics
components.summary: Top row of EBITDA summary metric cards
components.description: Row of summary metric cards across the top of the EBITDA section (actual, hodl, selling, cost). Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: EbitdaCharts
components.summary: Revenue, cost, and EBITDA chart panel
components.description: Chart panel inside the EBITDA section visualising revenue, cost, and EBITDA over time. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: ActualEbitdaCard
components.summary: Realised EBITDA stat card vs prior period
components.description: Stat card summarising the realised EBITDA for the selected reporting window vs the prior period. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: EbitdaHodlCard
components.summary: Projected EBITDA if all BTC is held
components.description: Stat card projecting EBITDA assuming all produced bitcoin is held instead of sold. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: EbitdaSellingCard
components.summary: Projected EBITDA if all BTC is sold
components.description: Stat card projecting EBITDA assuming all produced bitcoin is sold at the daily reference price. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: MonthlyEbitdaChart
components.description: Bar chart comparing EBITDA across the most recent months for trend visualisation. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: BitcoinPriceCard
components.description: Stat card showing the BTC reference price used by the reporting view with currency and timestamp. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: BitcoinProducedCard
components.summary: Bitcoin-produced stat card with prior-period delta
components.description: Stat card summarising the bitcoin produced during the reporting window with delta to prior period. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: BitcoinProducedChart
components.description: Time-series chart of bitcoin produced per day across the selected reporting window. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: BitcoinProductionCostCard
components.summary: Avg USD cost to produce one bitcoin
components.description: Stat card showing the average cost in USD to produce one bitcoin during the reporting window. Building block of the Ebitda composite.

components.name: EnergyBalanceRevenueCharts
components.description: Mosaic layout of revenue, downtime, and power charts for the energy balance revenue tab. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyBalanceRevenueMetrics
components.description: Grid of stat cards summarising energy revenue metrics for the selected period. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyBalanceCostCharts
components.description: Layout container for the energy cost tab charts: revenue-vs-cost bar chart and power line chart. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyBalanceCostMetrics
components.description: Grid of stat cards summarising energy cost metrics for the selected period. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyBalancePowerChart
components.description: Line chart visualising power consumption against threshold for the energy balance view. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyRevenueChart
components.summary: Energy revenue per MWh bar chart
components.description: Bar chart showing site energy revenue per MWh, with USD/BTC currency toggle. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyCostChart
components.summary: Revenue vs cost per MWh bar chart
components.description: Bar chart comparing site revenue vs cost per MWh, with USD/BTC currency toggle. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: EnergyMetricCard
components.description: Stat card for a single energy balance metric. Building block of the EnergyBalance composite.

components.name: CurrentAlerts
components.description: Sortable, searchable data table of currently active alerts derived from a raw devices payload. Building block of the Alerts composite.

components.name: AlertConfirmationModal
components.description: Modal that confirms acknowledging or clearing one or more alerts before applying the change. Building block of the Alerts composite.

components.name: AlertsTableTitle
components.summary: Alerts table title strip with count badge
components.description: Title strip for an alerts table with the section heading and an optional count badge. Building block of the Alerts composite.

components.name: TagFilterBar
components.description: Horizontal strip of removable tag chips that narrow a list view; clicking a chip removes the filter. Building block of the Alerts composite.

components.name: AlarmContents
components.summary: Alarm card body with details and next actions
components.description: Body region of an alarm card listing the alert details and recommended next actions. Building block of the Alerts composite.

components.name: AlarmRow
components.description: Single alarm-feed row with severity dot, timestamp, source device, and the alert message. Building block of the Alerts composite.

components.name: HashBalanceRevenuePanel
components.description: Revenue tab panel for hash balance - site hash revenue, network hashrate, hashprice charts, and currency toggle for per-PH/day units. Building block of the HashBalance composite.

components.name: HashBalanceCostPanel
components.description: Cost tab panel for hash balance - metric tiles and combined cost / revenue / network hashprice bar chart for the selected period. Building block of the HashBalance composite.

components.name: HashrateSiteView
components.description: Site-level hashrate trend - aggregates hashrate across the whole site for the selected date range, with an optional miner-type filter that scopes the sum to a subset. Building block of the Hashrate composite.

components.name: HashrateMinerTypeView
components.description: Hashrate drilldown grouped by miner model - bar chart of the latest hashrate per miner type, with an optional multi-select filter. Building block of the Hashrate composite.

components.name: HashrateMiningUnitView
components.description: Hashrate drilldown grouped by mining unit / container - bar chart of the latest hashrate per container with an optional multi-select filter. Building block of the Hashrate composite.

components.name: TimeframeWeekFlatContent
components.summary: Flat week-list for the week selector
components.description: Flat list of selectable week items for the TimeframeControls week selector. Shared building block of the reporting timeframe controls.

components.name: TimeframeWeekTreeContent
components.summary: Year-month-week tree for the week selector
components.description: Hierarchical year to month to week tree for the TimeframeControls week selector. Shared building block of the reporting timeframe controls.

components.name: LabeledCard
components.summary: Card with a header label and layout modifiers
components.description: Card variant that pairs a tiny label above the body - used for compact stat or metadata blocks. Supports an optional navigation link on the label and a set of layout modifiers.
